subject: Estevao struggles for minutes at Chelsea under Xabi Alonso
title: Estevao: ten league games, one start

lines.vo: Ten Premier League games, one start. Estevao is still waiting.
lines.footage: Estevao dribbling clip, Chelsea home match

lines.vo: He is struggling for minutes under Xabi Alonso at Chelsea. His one start was a 2-0 win over Manchester United. A perfect record.
lines.footage: Chelsea bench shots, Xabi Alonso on the touchline

lines.vo: Alonso likes a three-four-three. ESPN says it is a poor fit for him.
lines.footage: Tactical graphic, three at the back, then Estevao on the wing

lines.vo: Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers occupy the spots he likes.
lines.footage: Cole Palmer goal clip, Morgan Rogers highlights

lines.vo: Ancelotti has started him in four of Brazil's five games since the World Cup. Chelsea, one from ten.
lines.footage: Brazil match clip, Estevao running with the ball

lines.vo: Alonso says there are no plans to move him on. Now he needs the minutes.
lines.footage: Alonso press conference clip, Chelsea training ground

inserts.story: A cartoon teenage winger sits on a bench with a tiny flag. Gag: he waves the flag at the pitch with a hopeful look. Twist: a tiny bird lands on his flag and he whispers hello.

A cartoon manager holds a winger-shaped peg beside a formation board with a square hole. Gag: he tries to push the peg into the hole and it won't fit. Twist: the peg rotates into a perfect shape and clicks in.

facts_used: ESPN says Estevao has played in ten Premier League games this season with one start, the 2-0 home win over Man Utd (news id 31, espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50523536)
Alonso's preferred 3-4-3 is described as a poor fit for him; Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers occupy his favoured attacking spots (news id 31)
Ancelotti has started him in four of five post-World Cup games for Brazil; he has five international goals (news id 31)
Alonso has said there are no plans to move him on (news id 31)
notes: Non-comic. The source mentions a serious hamstring injury in the background field; it is deliberately left out as injury material. 'One from ten' means one start in ten Premier League games. 6-3 Carabao Cup win and half-time substitution are not used.
